purpose: Repair one located persistence/export precondition without claiming save, reopen, or export completion.
trigger: Use when failure is isolated to one path, format, permission, or other declared condition.

inputs.name: failed_precondition
inputs.description: One failed persistence/export precondition, exact error, and affected artifact.

inputs.name: target_artifact_identity
inputs.description: Expected path, format, role, and run ownership.

inputs.name: repair_strategy
inputs.description: One selected strategy such as new writable path or supported format.

preconditions: Failure is limited to one precondition and target artifact is known.
Repair strategy is selected before emitting a change.

outputs.name: repaired_condition
outputs.description: One corrected path/format/permission precondition and scope.

outputs.name: repair_action
outputs.description: One preparation action or needs_manual_review; no persistence command.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when cause or strategy is not specific enough.

postconditions: The emitted preparation action addresses exactly one precondition and preserves the declared artifact role/identity; repair execution is not claimed.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. Preparation only; EX-14 or a dedicated export/reopen atom performs actual persistence.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: More than one precondition may explain failure.
Preparation changes target role or identity.

recovery.action: Return needs_manual_review and isolate one cause.
Choose same-role run-owned target and recheck.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Exactly one precondition is repaired and artifact role/identity is preserved.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
